title: geodorum dilatatum
intro: Geodorum dilatatum, commonly known as the "white helmet orchid", is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Geodorum dilatatum include its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and microbial infections. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
